purpose: City-specific registry/map source review and safe route inspection for ranked WUP settlement point.
primaryPublisher: District Administration Firozabad; Uttar Pradesh Revenue Department
registryBasis: The official Firozabad district land-record page places the revenue tehsil office in Firozabad city and links Uttar Pradesh BHULEKH records. The state cadastral-map digitization dashboard has a Firozabad tehsil row with linked/georeferenced map-sheet progress. This verifies city-linked land-record administration but not public vector access or point-level coverage. This is Firozabad, Uttar Pradesh, India, not Faisalabad, Pakistan.

officialSources.observation: District Administration page says UP BHULEKH computerizes land records, links the portal, and identifies the related Revenue Department tehsil office in City: Firozabad.
UP government dashboard lists Firozabad tehsil map digitization status; it is an aggregate progress table, not parcel geometry.
Official Uttar Pradesh Board of Revenue page advertises revenue-village map and plot-boundary services; no plot identifier or property record was submitted.
